g.text: Complete native divisor translation — recorded scaling
Same native FLINT backend and identical frozen inputs for both arms; p=1,000,003 and 1,000,033.
Each point summarizes ten calls: five rounds in each field. These are descriptive repeats, not confidence bounds.
Trace loses at some small degrees and retains a quadratic recurrence. [pcc:unverified]
